description.value: Zen Japanese Restaurant is a contemporary sushi and Japanese cuisine destination on Marine Drive in West Vancouver, offering a sleek dining room with views of magnificent sunsets along the water. The menu spans sushi, sashimi, tempura, robata, and specialty rolls, with dine-in, pickup, and home delivery all available. It sits along a popular waterfront cycling corridor between West and North Vancouver, making it a natural meal stop for touring cyclists.

address.value: 101-2232 Marine Dr, West Vancouver, BC V7V 1K4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://www.zenjapanese.ca/ confirms an active, open Japanese restaurant — it has a live menu, online ordering, and contact details. The phone number (604) 925-0667 matches OSM's +1-604-925-0667, but the OSM website tag (www.zensushi.ca) differs from the discovered URL (www.zenjapanese.ca), and the OSM community field ('North Vancouver') contradicts the website's clear address of West Vancouver, BC V7V 1K4. Takeout is confirmed by the website statement 'Zen Japanese offers dine-in, pickup and home delivery service,' and multiple vegetarian items (Vegetable Roll, Edamame, Agedashi Tofu, Cauliflower Karaage, etc.) are identifiable in the online menu.
concerns: OSM website tag is 'www.zensushi.ca' but the discovered and confirmed website is 'www.zenjapanese.ca' — these differ and the OSM tag may be stale or refer to a different business.
OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly places the restaurant in West Vancouver, BC V7V 1K4 — a different municipality.
OSM address omits the unit number; website specifies unit 101 (101-2232 Marine Dr).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, open Japanese restaurant with a live website, confirmed phone number, and online ordering. A suitable Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists on the Marine Drive corridor.
